title: Spec-Driven Development: Write the Spec First, Let AI Build It
summary: The #1 technique for reliable AI-generated code: write a 7-section spec before prompting Claude Code or Cursor. Includes a reusable spec template that cuts iteration by 60%.
body_markdown: List every table the feature touches. For each: table name, column names, column types, constraints, relationships. Example:` User: { id UUID PK, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, verified_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP }` . If you can't write the data model, stop — you don't yet understand the feature well enough to build it.
